generation_method: Deterministically derived from existing Noonline SLA route conditions and field data gaps; no field result is inferred.

state_machine.ai_rule: AI may not create, observe, verify, reject, or self-certify field evidence.

tasks.evidence_required: Geolocated route-segment observation at the specified midday sampling window, including shade/solar-exposure record and attachment.
tasks.verification_method: Walk the declared reference axis segment; record continuous shaded and exposed intervals with timestamped, geolocated evidence.
tasks.pass_condition: Observed shaded coverage meets the pre-approved route threshold for the specified sampling window.
tasks.fail_condition: A gap beyond the approved exposure threshold is observed, or the route cannot be observed safely.
tasks.sla_effect: Blocks SLA-A promotion when not verified; rejection triggers route-service review.

tasks.evidence_required: Timestamped, geolocated walking survey showing the longest continuously exposed interval.
tasks.verification_method: Traverse the reference segment during the approved time window and measure each uninterrupted exposure interval.
tasks.pass_condition: The longest exposed interval is within the pre-approved maximum.
tasks.fail_condition: The longest exposed interval exceeds the pre-approved maximum or no reliable measurement is available.
tasks.sla_effect: Blocks SLA-A promotion when not verified; rejection triggers route-service review.

tasks.evidence_required: Geolocated accessible route trace comparing the declared reference route and the actual shade/access detour.
tasks.verification_method: Walk the practical accessible alternative in the approved summer sampling window; record distance and access constraints.
tasks.pass_condition: The measured detour is within the pre-approved threshold and preserves accessibility.
tasks.fail_condition: The detour exceeds the threshold, becomes inaccessible, or cannot be completed.
tasks.sla_effect: Blocks SLA-A promotion when not verified; rejection requires a remain-B or downgrade review.

tasks.evidence_required: Photographic or documented proof of fixed, legible, low-technology wayfinding covering the declared reference route.
tasks.verification_method: Walk the route with AI and mobile services unavailable; document each required direction/decision point.
tasks.pass_condition: All required decision points have legible, durable offline guidance under the approved accessibility criteria.
tasks.fail_condition: A required decision point lacks legible offline guidance or requires AI/mobile access to proceed.
tasks.sla_effect: Blocks SLA-A promotion when not verified and affects AI-OFF support.

tasks.evidence_required: Geolocated field record confirming the proposed node can be associated with a real, publicly accessible place or documenting why it cannot.
tasks.verification_method: Visit the declared node context; record location, public accessibility and an attachment.
tasks.pass_condition: The node can be located and its context supports the declared design role without claiming an existing service facility.
tasks.fail_condition: The location is inaccessible, materially inconsistent with the declared role, or cannot be located.
tasks.sla_effect: Blocks SLA-A promotion when the node is mandatory; rejection triggers siting revision or downgrade review.
